name: CachedSynthesizer.playText should queue request
summary: Implement priority synthesis queue with deduplication. playText() queues SynthesisRequest(text, context, playback:true); background synthesis queues with playback:false. Queue processor executes serially, merges duplicate requests (playback:true overrides false), processes on-demand before background. stopSpeaking() sets all playback flags to false.
